title: Figures 21-22: Ps atom simulation in 5-T field and TEM image of silica aerogel
description: Figure 21 is a 3D scatter plot of black and red point clouds (electron and positron distributions) in x, y, z axes in atomic units (a.u.), with E and B field arrows; caption: "Figure 21. Computer Simulation of Ps Atoms in a 5-Tesla Magnetic Field and 100 V/cm Electric Field (1 a.u. = 0.052 nm) (courtesy University of Bielefeld, Germany)." Figure 22 is a grayscale transmission electron micrograph of aerogel strands with a "20 nm" scale bar; caption: "Figure 22. TEM of Silica Aerogel (courtesy Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory)." Text discusses silica aerogel as a positronium storage medium.
